system.description:
Usage worn; Weight 1 lb.

The crystal-sided box is normally empty. Sacred symbols reflected in its surfaces briefly acquire additional strokes, as though an invisible annotator is correcting them.

You gain a +2-status bonus to Religion and Linguistics checks made to identify, translate or interpret prayers, sacred symbols, religious doctrine and ritual formulae.

On the sheet: +2 status is offered on Religion and Linguistics about prayers, symbols, doctrine and ritual.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

conditionals.label: Reliquary of the First Inscription
conditionals.scope: Religion and Linguistics checks to identify, translate or interpret prayers, sacred symbols, religious doctrine and ritual formulae
